data.subject: Public-record research for Patriot Financial
data.body:
Hi,

Your fund’s most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in NEWT and USCB.

On September 14, 2026, NEWT filed an earnings release (8-K Item 2.02, Exhibit 99.1) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1587987/000162828026061720/a3q2026dividendannouncem.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
